fc_start_stop_reward_scope: Low-load, high-load and cycle degradation are reported in physical costs only. The reward uses the existing transient cost, including the terminal transient once.
battery_equivalent_hydrogen_sign: Signed CNY reporting only. Discharge is positive and charge is negative.
battery_equivalence: Signed SOC cell-energy delta / fixed eta_fc_avg / LHV, without applying battery efficiency twice.
